blocks.text: IPv4 mein 4 numbers hote hain, har ek 0 se 255 tak, aur beech mein dots (nuqte) hote hain.

blocks.caption: IPv4 ke hisse
rows: Aap ka local network batata hai, jaise “Gulshan Block Street 3”
Us network par aap ka khaas device batata hai, jaise “House #10”

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: IPv4 ke kul mumkin addresses: taqreeban 4.29 billion (2³² = 4,294,967,296).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 8 bits mein sab se bara number 11111111 = 255 hai, is liye har hissa 0 se 255 tak hota hai. 192.168.1.10 mein "192.168.1" gali ka naam aur "10" makan number jaisa hai.
Yeh program IPv4 address ke chaaron numbers ko 8-bit binary mein dikhata hai aur network aur host part alag karta hai. address badal kar Run karein.

address = "192.168.1.10"

numbers = address.split(".")
for number in numbers:
    print(number, "=", format(int(number), "08b"))

print("Network part:", ".".join(numbers[:3]))
print("Host part:", numbers[3])
print("Total bits:", len(numbers) * 8)
print("Total IPv4 addresses:", 2 ** 32)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"address = "192.168.1.10"": kitab wala IPv4 address.
"numbers = address.split(".")": address ko dots par tor kar list banata hai: ['192', '168', '1', '10'].
"for number in numbers": har number ke liye "format(int(number), "08b")" use 8 binary digits mein likhta hai ("08b" = 8 jagah, shuru mein zero, binary).
"".".join(numbers[:3])": pehle teen numbers ko dots se jor kar network part banata hai; "numbers[3]" chautha number yani host part.
"len(numbers) * 8": 4 x 8 = 32 bits. "2 ** 32": 32 bits se ban'ne wale kul addresses.
Output: "192 = 11000000", "168 = 10101000", "1 = 00000001", "10 = 00001010", "Network part: 192.168.1", "Host part: 10", "Total bits: 32", "Total IPv4 addresses: 4294967296" (yani taqreeban 4.29 billion).
Khud try karein: address = "10.0.0.255" kar ke Run karein: "255 = 11111111" aata hai, yani 8 bits ka sab se bara number.

blocks.prompt: 192.168.1.10 mein network part aur host part kaun se hain, aur IPv4 mein kul kitne bits hain?
blocks.explanation: Network part 192.168.1, host part 10. Kul 4 x 8 = 32 bits.

items: IPv4: 4 numbers (0-255), dots se alag; har number 8 bits; kul 32 bits; network part + host part; taqreeban 4.29 billion addresses.
